title: Day 2 · uv, pytest and Python basics

cards.q: What four things does `uv add --dev pytest` change in a project?
cards.a: It creates the .venv environment, installs pytest into it, adds pytest to the dev dependency group in pyproject.toml, and records exact versions in uv.lock.

cards.q: Why run `uv run pytest` instead of `pytest`?
cards.a: uv run executes the command inside the project's own .venv, with its Python and installed packages, so the tests can import your package. A bare pytest may be missing or use a different Python.

cards.q: Why does `def add_item(item, items=[])` keep growing across calls, and what is the fix?
cards.a: The default list is created once, when the function is defined, and every call shares it. Use `items=None`, then `if items is None: items = []` inside the function.
